home.intro: I build web and mobile applications end to end: from the interface to the database and payments. I work with React, React Native, TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL/Supabase, and I'm looking for my first Junior Full Stack / Front End role to build products that solve real problems.

about.title: About me
about.text:
I'm a Full Stack Developer trained at the Desafío Latam bootcamp (2024), with personal projects ever since. I come from the health field (Medical Technology), which gave me process discipline and domain insight for products like the one I built: a medication management app.

As a freelancer I built a SaaS mobile app end to end, with multitenant authentication, offline-first behavior and Stripe subscriptions. I have also maintained existing websites and have basic knowledge of WordPress and Python. My English is C1, so I can work with teams and documentation in English.

I like learning through real projects: right now I'm going deeper into TypeScript and Next.js.

projects.title: Projects
projects.recuerda_desc: SaaS mobile app for medication management, built as a freelance Full Stack developer. Offline-first architecture synced with Supabase, multitenant authentication with Row Level Security, and Stripe subscriptions (Checkout, customer portal and webhooks). Android builds with EAS Build.
projects.babies_desc: C2C marketplace to buy and sell second-hand baby items. React frontend, a custom REST API in Node.js + Express with JWT authentication and protected routes, and a PostgreSQL database.
projects.portfolio_desc: This site: bilingual (ES/EN), responsive, accessible and deployed on Vercel, with basic SEO and a link preview when shared. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
projects.gremio_desc: Frontend site for a tabletop RPG group where players pick the missions for each session.
projects.jabones_desc: Responsive landing page for a handmade soap brand, built with React components and Bootstrap and deployed on Vercel.
